items: 3 chicken breasts, cooked and shredded or chopped
Carrots, celery, black or kidney beans, as desired

steps.title: Sauté the vegetables
steps.body: Sauté in a large kettle with a bit of oil for several minutes: **1 onion**, chopped, **1 jalapeno**, chopped, **2 garlic cloves**, pressed, and **1 × 15 oz stewed tomatoes**.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.body: Add and simmer for 30 minutes: **4 cups chicken broth**, **1 × 10 oz tomato soup**, **1 × 15 oz canned corn**, **1 tsp ground cumin**, **2 tsp Worcestershire sauce**, **3 chicken breasts**, cooked and shredded or chopped, **2 tsp lemon pepper**, and carrots, celery, or black or kidney beans, as desired.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Serve with tortilla chips, grated cheddar cheese and sour cream.
